from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title or label of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal proceeding, e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
